It was conceived and founded in 2007 by [[Hapoel Jerusalem F.C.|Hapoel Jerusalem]] fans unhappy with the club's management. At its founding, Hapoel Katamon Jerusalem became the first fan-owned football club in Israel. In May 2020, the club's Council decided to rename the club to Hapoel Jerusalem, and changed the logo accordingly."}}
